title: MEO farmer microgrant program
summary: The council changed its agricultural microgrant rules on May 15 to favor farmers who are carrying out the Maui County Food and Nutrition Security Plan 2025–2030. Under the rules, no more than 10% of each microgrant may be used for fencing.
